block.comment: This creates a polygon with 360 sides which is a good approximation for a circle. Actually even a 30 sided polygon would work. The move input in that case would be larger.
1.OP.4 TIF A Insert this line first thing in the REPEAT 360 for the thickness one.
More TIF A: Insert this instead for colors.
To create color variation use this block at the start to initialize.
24 circles will cover 360 degrees, so each circle must be rotated by 360/24=15 degrees

113 steps is approximately the diameter of the circles drawn by DRAW CIRCLE, determined empirically (draw circle, turn left 90 degrees, move forward and back. 100 is too small, 110 is too small, 111 is too small...) If your students know enough math to compute the curvature of the circle from the code, they can get an exact value for the diameter.
